name: What types of surfaces can Frasheski Construction restore?

mainEntity.name: What types of surfaces can Frasheski Construction restore?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction specializes in restoring a variety of surfaces commonly found in residential and commercial properties. This includes concrete patios, driveways, and walkways, natural stone features, various types of tile, and wood decks or flooring. Our expertise allows us to assess the specific needs of each material and apply appropriate restoration techniques to achieve optimal results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction can restore concrete, natural stone, tile, and wood surfaces in homes and businesses.
